title: Java Tea Original Virtua Fighter Kids
native_title: ジャワティオリジナル　バーチャファイターキッズ
overview:
Get Ready to Rumble...

Experience the killer gameplay of Virtua Fighter 2, packed into a pint sized punch!

- 20% faster than Virtua Fighter 2!
- Amazing special moves!
- Hidden secrets await the true Virtua Fighter master!
- New: Real-time instant replays!
- New: Customize characters with the new "Make-your-own-combos" mode!
- New: Original movie sequences!
